stages: API targeted full-timeline search for source_unresolved or newly detected gaps
source observation with complete question/options and without reference
denser original-source audit with reference; fresh facts/citations permitted
at most one targeted supplementation round if unresolved
scope: Process initial50 distinct new questions/videos; add frozen reserve batches only until cumulative unique source_supported_multi >=51. Baseline32 from previous fixed50; preserve all old results.
time_annotations: Video-MME QA provides no authoritative fact-level temporal gold used here; caption windows are proposals. Refined spans are sampled source witness intervals, not frame-perfect event boundaries.
modalities: Original decoded video frames and synchronized original SRT; no audio stream. Claims needing audio without usable subtitles remain unresolved.
resume: Only interrupted entries resume with stage caches; every terminal outcome retained. Initial50 all processed, then reserve batches of5 until target51 or pool exhausted. Stop marker/API circuit respected.
evidence_contract: API cites exact current source IDs; code derives original timestamp spans, including point witnesses, and preserves disjoint observed intervals. Retrieval windows are not semantic groups. No API-authored timestamp or input-group-ID constraints.
acceptance: Final source audit determines required gaps; earlier missing items and optional notes do not veto resolved evidence. No passing with final required gaps, unsupported facts/relations, reference conflict or inconsistent multi-group declarations.

code_base.changes: Separate output root; every new candidate starts full-timeline API search; frozen selection, target-aware scheduler and cumulative export; classify RemoteProtocolError as API failure. Source acceptance unchanged.

selection.stratification: round-robin groups2,3,4plus; seeded shuffle per stratum
